    Anderson Brothers play Benny Goodman

    7:00 PM · Birdland Jazz Club, Hell's Kitchen · $35.46

    Grammy-Winning virtuosos on clarinet (New York Times), the Juilliard graduates, identical twins, and Washington, DC natives Peter Sing, Sing, Sing, Stompin at the Savoy, Lets Dance, and Dont Be That Way. Raised in poverty in Chicago, Benny Goodman was a classical clarinet prodigy who sparked an international swing craze in the 1930s, and premiered the first jazz concert at Carnegie Hall in 1938. Peter and Will Anderson have headlined at The Blue Note, Jazz at Lincoln Center, The Kennedy Center, New Orleans Jazz Festival, Feinsteins 54 Below, live on Garrison Keillors Prairie Home Companion, and can be heard on the Grammy-winning soundtrack of HBOs Boardwalk Empire with Vince Giordanos Nighthawks. Peter and Will can be heard and seen in the major motion pictures Revolutionary Road, Killers of the Flower Moon, Boardwalk Empire, and The Marvelous Ms. Maisel. www.PeterAndWillAnderson.com

    Google Calendar

    A Ghost in Your Ear

    7:00 PM · Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Most days

    When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.
